reason: New pattern (cause of the M3 finding): a part's thickness lives only in a skin-check set. The kit samples a strap or link at its skin-facing face (M.rigid / M.link_pts) and keeps its top face, hub crowns and knee-link top as 'contact-only' sets (checked against the skin, not scored). Any clearance PLACEMENT or metal-to-metal jam rule that reads only rigid + link sets (this model's need_scan, model lines 165-207, and the parent sector rule it extends for names knee/E/boss/hub3/L2/pad) sees a 3 mm strap as a 0 mm sheet. In the parent offset-shortcar the rigid bump lifted the contact sets with the strap, so the parent's verifier X1 found 0 new jams; removing the bump is exactly what exposed it. Any future under-pass, bridge or stacked-relay model that reuses need_scan inherits a 3 mm (T_LINK) optimism.
